ownership: Root proposed the positions-conditioned diagnostic after1264. bounded_idea_supply checked the algebra, identified a source-free joint-confound counterexample and reviewed nearby methods. No native tables, payloads, new counts, samples or learned labels were constructed.
fixed_inputs: Retain1264's learned ZL class map, working-unit parsing, exterior-unit trimming, odd/even physical-leaf split and unscorable-unit treatment. Apply the unchanged map to alternate readers. Source page selector, interior length n and pair position j define each TEST contingency cell. No label refit is made on TEST.

cell_algebra.counts: Let a=n00, b=n01, c=n10, d=n11 and N=a+b+c+d>0. Row totals r0=a+b,r1=c+d; column totals c0=a+c,c1=b+d. Use separate names for N, the number of paired observations in this cell, and n, the length of a word interior.
cell_algebra.normalized_difference: Delta/N=-2 times the empirical binary covariance computed with divisor N.
cell_algebra.informative: Both margins vary exactly when r0>0,r1>0,c0>0,c1>0. All four individual cells need NOT be positive. If either margin is constant, Delta is exactly0; this mechanical equality is not confirmation of independence.
cell_algebra.expectation_interpretation: E is the expected crossing count if the N observed right-column labels are uniformly paired with the N fixed left labels within this one cell. It is also the empirical product-margin baseline. There is no N-1 correction for this matching expectation.

important_counterexample.purpose: The new margin contrast and1264's bag contrast do not jointly condition on BOTH word composition and position. Both can be positive in a model with only a fixed bag and a positional preference, without a further neighbor interaction.
important_counterexample.generating_description: Every word contains exactly2A and1B. Choose the B location at positions1,2,3 with probabilities1/5,3/5,1/5. This is a positional weight conditioned on the fixed bag; no adjacent-pair potential is needed.
important_counterexample.old_bag_endpoint: The five words have8 observed crossings in total.1264's uniform-bag expectation is5*(2*2*1/3)=20/3. The bag excess is therefore4/3, positive.
important_counterexample.new_endpoint: At each position N=5, O=4, E=14/5 and Delta=6/5. The total Delta across ten edges is12/5, hence Delta/all_edges=0.24, also positive. Both position cells are informative.
important_counterexample.conclusion: Positive old and new endpoints would not establish an increment beyond a JOINT bag-plus-position model. This is an interpretation limit, not a claim that the supplied synthetic mechanism explains the manuscript.

conditioning_not_relearning: The binary symbol labels remain learned only from the frozen TRAIN partition. TEST margins are computed because they define a descriptive conditional association statistic, not because a new symbol classifier is being trained.
This is not an out-of-sample probability model for positions. Calling the observed-margin subtraction a learned positional predictor would be inaccurate.

For each cohort ALL,UNSEEN_INTERIOR andUNSEEN_WHOLE, recompute its own cell counts and margins from that same cohort if the intended endpoint is that cohort's conditional association. Using ALL margins for a subset instead defines a different reference and does not satisfy the subset determinant identity above.

UNSEEN_INTERIOR must mean absence of the exact trimmed working-unit sequence from the same reader's odd-leaf training vocabulary. It is stricter than unseen whole form, but does not require an unseen binary pattern or an unseen family structure.
No phrase, glyph value, word meaning, training label or extra class is selected from the new conditional scores.
aggregation_and_gates_to_freeze: For each physical leaf, sum Delta over its page-selector/length/position cells and divide by ALL scored edges on that leaf, including edges in uninformative cells. Such cells contribute zero numerator but retain their denominator cost.
Keep page-selector conditioning distinct from physical-leaf aggregation. Recto/verso and extra selectors of one physical leaf must not become independent leaves.

Define an informative leaf explicitly, naturally as one containing at least one informative cell. It can still have total Delta=0 through cancellation. Zero is not positive for the two-thirds sign gate.

The requested minimum10informative leaves, two-thirds positive informative leaves and mean excess>=0.01 are declared engineering criteria, not p-value thresholds. The mean's leaf population must be frozen explicitly: informative leaves only OR every leaf with scored edges. Report both if useful, but do not choose between them after seeing the outcome.

A leaf or cohort with no scored edges has no defined rate. Keep it as a capacity/exclusion case rather than silently replacing its score by zero. An edge-bearing but uninformative leaf has a genuine zero contrast and should be reported separately.
Use exact rational arithmetic where practical. Every cell's sign can be checked by b*c-a*d; avoid numerical positivity from roundoff at a zero determinant.

Expose informative-cell sizes and all denominators. A cell with only two observations can already be informative and strongly positive or negative; several such cells are not automatically strong independent evidence.
not_a_coherent_text_null: A word contributes multiple overlapping adjacent pairs at different j. Independently repairing pairings in each contingency cell can assign incompatible labels to the shared middle position of a word.

Consequently the cell matching interpretation alone is not a distribution of coherent complete texts preserving their bags or other constraints. No whole-text permutation p-value, independence assertion or Monte Carlo reference follows from summing these expectations.

Repeated exact words, repeated binary patterns and overlapping edges remain dependent observations. Equal physical-leaf weighting does not remove all such dependence or turn alternate readings into replications.

nearby_predecessors.difference: 1264 learns the fixed split and evaluates against each interior's uniform symbol bag. It explicitly leaves position-specific frequencies open. The new statistic fixes those marginal frequencies at page/length/position resolution but does not also preserve each word bag.

Its specified form grid and prefix/kernel/metadata strata are not the frozen binary whole-interior position question.

849describes a3x3outer/inner e-position grid within fixed literal wrappers;854's different cross-kernel neighbor transfer stopped on capacity. Neither supplies this all-interior binary adjacency residual. No e-placement role or semantic value is inherited.

Those controls concern terminal r/l on separate whole words and token-label assignments with leaf/stem/position or added line margins. They are different randomization objects; the exact-text sampler1261stopped on computational capacity and is not revived by independent pair-cell marginals.

bounded_prior_verdict: The inspected relevant methods and bounded route/idea lookup expose prior contingency arithmetic and position concerns, but no identical executed frozen-binary TEST page/length/position contrast. No exhaustive absence claim is made. No new RAW is needed to rename this methodological diagnostic.
decision_ceiling: The proposed computation is valid as a separately scoped descriptive class-association check conditional on observed position margins. Any positive should be stated at that level only: it does not by itself establish syllables, vowel/consonant roles, a genuine writer, semantic composition, phonetics, H2compression or dependence beyond a joint bag-and-position mechanism. Root owns scientific selection, final gate definitions and any execution.
